not_working_items.title: It expired or sold out:
not_working_items.body: many SAB codes have limited stock rather than a fixed end time.

not_working_items.title: It was already redeemed:
not_working_items.body: public codes are normally one redemption per account, while DLC codes are generally single-use.

not_working_items.body: copy the exact uppercase string and remove hidden spaces.

not_working_items.title: The server is out of date:
not_working_items.body: rejoin a current server after a game update, then try once more.

not_working_items.title: You cannot collect the reward:
not_working_items.body: a Red Carpet spawn still requires enough cash and can be taken by another player.

faq_items.question: What is the active Steal a Brainrot code in {month}?
faq_items.answer: The active shared code at the latest check is BESTBRAINROTEVER, which spawns La Vacca Saturno Saturnita on the Red Carpet.

faq_items.question: What does randomly generated code mean in Steal a Brainrot?
faq_items.answer: It means an eligible DLC or merchandise purchase may include a unique, single-use code. The code is not a public string, and its reward is selected from the documented reward pool.

faq_items.question: Why is my Steal a Brainrot code not working?
faq_items.answer: The code may be expired, sold out, already redeemed, entered with the wrong capitalization, or pasted with an extra space. Single-use DLC codes also stop working after one successful redemption.

faq_items.question: Are Steal a Brainrot codes case-sensitive?
faq_items.answer: Treat codes as case-sensitive and copy the exact uppercase spelling shown in the active list.

faq_items.question: Where can I find new Steal a Brainrot codes?
faq_items.answer: Check the official Roblox experience and its current social links, the community Wiki Codes page, and this page after game updates or Admin Abuse events.
